title: Clipboard
description: Clipboard sync (capability clipboard). clip-push carries text or image one way. Text is plain-text max 262144 chars (256KB); images are base64-encoded PNG/JPEG/WEBP/GIF/TIFF/HEIC max 5 MiB raw (~7.1 MiB b64). Auto and manual caps are both 5 MiB. changed_at orders pushes; origin breaks echo loops. kind discriminates text vs image. filename is optional basename (max 255) for UTI/extension preservation; absent peers synthesize from mime.

app_version.description: Human app version, e.g. 0.4.0. Display-only; older peers omit it.

nonce.description: Random per-message value the ack must echo.

kind.description: Discriminator: text or image. Absent means text for backward compat.

text.description: Plain-text clipboard content (kind=text). Never logged verbatim.

mime.description: Image MIME, e.g. image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp, image/gif, image/tiff, image/heic.

image_b64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (kind=image). Max 5 MiB raw.

changed_at.description: Unix seconds when the content was copied at the origin.

origin.description: Which side copied; receivers drop echoes of their own origin.

filename.description: Optional original basename (sanitized, no dirs) for UTI/extension preservation; absent peers synthesize clip-<ts>.<ext> from mime. Old peers ignore it.
